about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Hedhli Saber, a 2nd-year Communications & Networks Engineering student at the National Engineering School of Gabès (ENIG).
about.p2: My work spans telecom field operations, Cisco-certified networking, and embedded plus AI systems — unified by one focus: make connected systems reliable in the real world, then make them intelligent at the edge.
